purpose: Enterprise readiness preflight for enabling Secrets Manager rotation on the Ventus Aurora database credential secret.
strict_mode_goal: Do not enable DB credential rotation until the live cluster, secret shape, rotation app availability, Lambda network path, and rollback checks all pass.

rotation_lambda.required_runtime: provided by AWS Serverless Application Repository template

pre_enable_gates: Rotation Lambda is deployed in the same VPC path as the backend Lambdas.
Rotation Lambda security group can reach Aurora PostgreSQL on port 5432 without adding public ingress.
Rotation Lambda role can read and update only the DB credential secret and decrypt alias/ventus/database-secrets.
A staging or maintenance-window smoke test confirms API health and authenticated enrichment after a manual rotation test.
Rollback owner is assigned before enablement.
rollback_checks: Invalid API key request returns 403, proving the API Lambda can decrypt the DB secret and query Aurora.
Authenticated enrichment smoke reaches complete for a small batch.
If any check fails, disable rotation, restore the prior AWSCURRENT version if needed, and redeploy the last known-good backend package.

live_status.notes: The AWS-managed PostgreSQL single-user rotation Lambda is deployed through CDK. Secrets Manager DB credential rotation remains disabled until a reviewed manual rotation test and rollback checks pass.
